scope: Current communications-notifications behavior examples. Fixture names are stable labels, not prescribed internal API types. One group may be proven by one table-driven test. Named subcases share the parent case ID; all their effects must be checked.

cases.requirement: Spring/fall DST due days end at next local-day start, not fixed 24 h/UTC midnight; stored LocalDate stays identical.
cases.description: Chicago all-day deadlines 2026-03-08 and 2026-11-01, 23/25 hour days, compare next local midnight.

checks: Recipient account deduped, exact valid owners only, no phantom plant/inbox; durable mail failure never undoes association.
